node.text: An Indian technology company connecting people, businesses and opportunity.
MoolSocial is designed for people, creators, businesses and local partners to discover content, access services, trade, work and grow through one trusted platform.
More of everyday life, in one place
Watch and create content, shop, book local services, travel and pay through one MoolSocial account.
Build an audience, work with businesses and earn through eligible content and commerce opportunities.
Connect retail, wholesale, services and delivery businesses with customers across India.
Bring customer discovery, commerce, partnerships and talent together through MoolSocial.
One connected experience, built around real life.
Watch, create, shop, book, ride, pay and work—all within MoolSocial.
MoolSocial uses AI to make discovery, assistance and business tools more useful while keeping account, publishing, commerce and payment choices clear and under your control.
Access content, everyday services and opportunities through a consistent identity and experience.
You choose what to publish, buy, share, connect and pay for. MoolSocial asks for confirmation before completing your request.
Prices, commitments and important conditions are presented clearly before you proceed.
Register for launch news, early access and opportunities before MoolSocial opens across India.
Receive relevant launch news, early-access information and opportunities.
See public updates about MoolSocial, its people, partnerships and launch.
Explore content, commerce, services, mobility, payments and work in one place.
We welcome applications and partnership proposals from people and organisations with relevant expertise, local knowledge and a commitment to dependable service.
Applications are open for 100+ planned roles across India.
We welcome résumés for upcoming opportunities in technology, product, operations, sales, partnerships, customer support, community, commerce and city teams.
Include your preferred role, city, experience and availability. MoolSocial never charges an application or recruitment fee.
We welcome proposals from freelancers, creators, retailers, wholesalers, brands, service providers, quick-commerce operators and delivery partners.
Tell us what you offer, where you operate and how you would like to work with MoolSocial.
